account.title: Account
account.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
account.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

common.crashBody: The app hit an unexpected error. You can try again or restart the app.
common.authUnavailableBody: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.

foundation.emptyBody: New activities will appear here when they are ready.
foundation.contactBody: Have a question or want to get in touch with the LINK team?
foundation.sharedAccount: Your profile and password are shared with the LINK website.
foundation.deleteWarning: This deletes your LINK account on both the mobile app and website. Your data in both apps will be removed. This cannot be undone.
foundation.syncError: We could not load your mobile account. Check your connection and try again.
foundation.signOutError: Could not sign out. Please try again.

privacy.accountBody: Clerk manages your sign-in details. The mobile app stores your Clerk account ID, email, username, name and profile image URL in its own database. It does not store your password.
privacy.sharedBody: Your login and profile are shared with the LINK website. Mobile activity data is kept separately. This version does not record audio or collect lesson results.
privacy.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes your shared Clerk identity and starts data removal in both apps. The mobile database keeps only an opaque account ID and deletion time so delayed updates cannot restore deleted information. Technical request counters expire automatically.
privacy.contactHint: Use Contact us in Account to ask the LINK team about your data.

lessons.quitBody: Your progress in this lesson will not be saved.
lessons.buildSentence: Tap the words to build your answer
lessons.tileAdd: Tap to add this word to your answer
lessons.exerciseMissing: This exercise could not be loaded.
lessons.summaryPerfect: You got everything right the first time.

speaking.quitBody: This conversation will not be saved.
speaking.title: Practise speaking
speaking.intro: A tutor will talk with you in your language. When it asks, say the English out loud.
speaking.privacy: Your voice goes to Google's Gemini AI so the tutor can understand you. The LINK Project does not keep your recordings.
speaking.data: This uses mobile data. Wi-Fi is best.
speaking.micBlocked: The microphone is turned off for this app. Turn it on in Settings to practise speaking.
speaking.nothingToPractise: There is nothing to practise speaking in this lesson yet.
speaking.tooShort: That was too short. Try speaking a little longer.
speaking.recordFailed: The microphone could not start. Please try again.
speaking.noAudio: No sound for this message. Please read it.
speaking.sendFailed: The tutor could not answer. Check your connection and try again.
speaking.tooMany: Please wait a minute, then try again.
